scope: E23 additive task audit plus new real-tool callback and early-snapshot-release ablation

e23_audit.delta_convention: candidate progress minus baseline timed; positive means slower; save is a subset of pre_tool, not additive

method.workload: New affine repair calc(x)=2*x+1 checked at 3 and 9, rotate/xor digest; actual FAIL/write/PASS/PASS; fast read control; no synthetic performance sleep
method.training: Three complete tasks per case/state before evaluation; identical restore calibration labels and independent mode keys; EWMA only past own-mode labels
method.controls: Timed no-event vs event isolates observation pathway; progress return vs early release isolates cleanup placement; absolute timestamps for callback and thread launch
method.costs: Save/evict/tools/repair/suffix/cleanup included; initial history/load/calibration/oracle excluded and recorded; full additive task identity
method.order: Modes rotate by replicate; fixed alpha/margin/strategy before new evaluation; no best-run selection

limits: One M5/Metal/model, warm OS file cache; no Windows/CUDA/cold SSD claim
Tool duration can include interference and OS/frequency/cache variation; matched repeats do not isolate all causal resource contention
Direct callback wall time is not all possible system interference; stage medians are not additive
Early file release does not shrink physical KV buffer; default snapshot cleanup and timed policy remain unchanged
Scripted real tools and fresh-KV oracle; not autonomous model ability

sanitizers.scope: Early-drop timer/inflight/ready cancellation and tool exception; Native/14K/KV/Stream; cxf/adapters instrumented, prebuilt upstream library excluded

cli_integration.scope: Native CLI registration/store/worker/tool path with deterministic Native-parser actions

measured_source_snapshot.scope: Private source contents excluded from publication; exact measured source hashes above
